title: Declare and Print a Matrix
description: Declare a 3x3 integer matrix with values of your choice, and print the element at position [1][2].
hints: Use int[][] with values inside braces {{...}, {...}, {...}}
solutionExplanation: We declare a 3x3 matrix using the simplified syntax. Index [1][2] corresponds to row 1 (the second row) and column 2 (the third column), which contains the value 6.

title: Sum of All Elements
description: Given a 3x4 matrix with values, calculate and print the total sum of all its elements using nested loops.
hints: Use an outer for loop for rows and an inner one for columns
Accumulate in an int variable suma = 0
matriz.length gives the rows, matriz[i].length gives the columns
solutionExplanation: The outer loop goes through the 3 rows. The inner loop goes through the 4 columns of each row. We add each element to the suma accumulator. The total is 61.

title: Transpose a Matrix
description: Given a 2x3 matrix, create a new 3x2 matrix that is its transpose (swap rows for columns) and print both.
hints: The transpose swaps rows for columns
If original is 2x3, transpuesta will be 3x2
solutionExplanation: The transpose swaps rows for columns. If original is 2x3, transpuesta must be 3x2. We assign transpuesta[col][ren] = original[ren][col]. We use Arrays.deepToString() to print both matrices.
